evidence.claim: EBV, nata nel 2019 a Venezia Mestre, lavora con destinazioni, enti pubblici e brand per realizzare campagne rivolte a un pubblico internazionale nelle città europee.
evidence.quote: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Venezia Mestre, Italy, EBV is a destination marketing and advertising execution platform operating across Southern Europe. || headquartered in Venezia Mestre, Italy || EBV works with destinations, public sector organisations, and brands to execute advertising initiatives that engage premium international audiences across key European cities.
